findings: Current official mobility page says the national Liberte offer bills actual consumption in kWh and the SEMOB subscription is 45 EUR/month for 100 kWh, i.e. 0.45 EUR/kWh instead of 0.59 EUR/kWh.
Official material also states that Liberte pricing depends on each network; therefore 0.59 EUR/kWh cannot safely be applied to every E-Totem-operated EVSE.

Older official station/network pages show materially different tariffs (for example Saint-Etienne network and individual retail-site examples), confirming that historical or network-specific values must not be extrapolated.
The public charging map itself is a JavaScript shell and did not expose an anonymous indexed station-level tariff payload in this pass. The private account surface is authenticated.
